fact: The Gamswitch release says the Central Bank of The Gambia provided regulatory leadership and oversight for BANTABA 2.0, the national switch that went live after a pilot and is operated by Gamswitch.
DPI Map lists Gamswitch as an active national interbank payment system operated by the Central Bank, with 12 participants in 2023, supporting P2P, P2G and P2B, with RTGS and ACH settlement.
PAPSS lists Gambia as a country with live send-and-receive participants: seven banks (Access, AGIB, Bloom, Ecobank, First Bank, Trust Bank, Vista).
